verdict.rationale: Serving LoRA adapters on top of a base model is a fair question for a local model-serving runtime like LocalAI, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions LoRA adapters, adapter hot-swapping, or multi-adapter serving. The pack only covers OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, MCP, the model gallery, aliasing and distributed nodes, none of which address this story.
